options.content:
- This dashboard shows **bounded cycle time** between configurable Jira statuses.
- Select **Start Status** and **End Status** to measure time for specific workflow phases (e.g., "In Progress" to "Verified").
- Use this to understand actual development cycle time excluding backlog wait time.
- PR metrics show associated pull request timing for issues within the bounded range.

panels.description: Average time from first entry into Start Status to first entry into End Status

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounded_issues AS (
  SELECT 
    i.id as issue_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN ish.original_status = '${start_status}' THEN ish.start_date END) as start_time,
    MIN(CASE WHEN ish.original_status = '${end_status}' THEN ish.start_date END) as end_time
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON i.id = bi.issue_id
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON bi.board_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
  JOIN issue_status_history ish ON i.id = ish.issue_id
  WHERE 
    pm.project_name IN (${project})
    AND i.original_type IN (${issue_type})
    AND ish.original_status IN ('${start_status}', '${end_status}')
  GROUP BY i.id
  HAVING start_time IS NOT NULL 
    AND end_time IS NOT NULL 
    AND end_time > start_time
    AND $__timeFilter(end_time)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, start_time, end_time) / 60.0) as 'Average Bounded Cycle Time (h)'
FROM bounded_issues

panels.description: Median time from first entry into Start Status to first entry into End Status

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounded_issues AS (
  SELECT 
    i.id as issue_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN ish.original_status = '${start_status}' THEN ish.start_date END) as start_time,
    MIN(CASE WHEN ish.original_status = '${end_status}' THEN ish.start_date END) as end_time
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON i.id = bi.issue_id
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON bi.board_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
  JOIN issue_status_history ish ON i.id = ish.issue_id
  WHERE 
    pm.project_name IN (${project})
    AND i.original_type IN (${issue_type})
    AND ish.original_status IN ('${start_status}', '${end_status}')
  GROUP BY i.id
  HAVING start_time IS NOT NULL 
    AND end_time IS NOT NULL 
    AND end_time > start_time
    AND $__timeFilter(end_time)
),
ranked_issues AS (
  SELECT 
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, start_time, end_time) / 60.0 as cycle_time_hours,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, start_time, end_time)) as pct_rank
  FROM bounded_issues
)
SELECT 
  AVG(cycle_time_hours) as 'Median Bounded Cycle Time (h)'
FROM ranked_issues
WHERE pct_rank <= 0.5

panels.title: 2. Median Bounded Cycle Time

panels.description: Average time spent in each status within the bounded range

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounded_issues AS (
  SELECT 
    i.id as issue_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN ish.original_status = '${start_status}' THEN ish.start_date END) as start_time,
    MIN(CASE WHEN ish.original_status = '${end_status}' THEN ish.start_date END) as end_time
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON i.id = bi.issue_id
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON bi.board_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
  JOIN issue_status_history ish ON i.id = ish.issue_id
  WHERE 
    pm.project_name IN (${project})
    AND i.original_type IN (${issue_type})
    AND ish.original_status IN ('${start_status}', '${end_status}')
  GROUP BY i.id
  HAVING start_time IS NOT NULL 
    AND end_time IS NOT NULL 
    AND end_time > start_time
    AND $__timeFilter(end_time)
),
status_first_occurrence AS (
  SELECT 
    ish.issue_id,
    ish.original_status,
    MIN(ish.start_date) as first_occurrence,
    SUM(ish.status_time_minutes) as total_minutes
  FROM issue_status_history ish
  JOIN bounded_issues bi ON ish.issue_id = bi.issue_id
  GROUP BY ish.issue_id, ish.original_status
),
filtered_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    sfo.original_status,
    SUM(sfo.total_minutes) / 60.0 as total_hours,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sfo.issue_id) as issue_count,
    MIN(sfo.first_occurrence) as earliest_first_occurrence
  FROM status_first_occurrence sfo
  JOIN bounded_issues bi ON sfo.issue_id = bi.issue_id
  WHERE sfo.first_occurrence >= bi.start_time 
    AND sfo.first_occurrence < bi.end_time
    AND sfo.original_status != '${end_status}'
    AND sfo.original_status NOT IN (${exclude_status})
  GROUP BY sfo.original_status
)
SELECT 
  original_status as 'Status',
  ROUND(total_hours / issue_count, 2) as 'Average Hours'
FROM filtered_statuses
ORDER BY CASE original_status
  WHEN 'Opened' THEN 1
  WHEN 'Requirements Blocked' THEN 2
  WHEN 'In Grooming' THEN 3
  WHEN 'Ready for Development' THEN 4
  WHEN 'Development Blocked' THEN 5
  WHEN 'In Progress' THEN 6
  WHEN 'Code Review' THEN 7
  WHEN 'Ready for SQA' THEN 8
  WHEN 'Ready for SQE' THEN 9
  WHEN 'In SQA Review' THEN 10
  WHEN 'SQA Blocked' THEN 11
  WHEN 'Redo' THEN 12
  WHEN 'Verified' THEN 13
  ELSE 99
END

panels.description: Average time from first commit to PR creation

targets.rawSql:
WITH _prs AS (
  SELECT
    pr.id,
    pr.created_date as pr_issued_date,
    COALESCE(prm.pr_coding_time/60, 0) as coding_time
  FROM pull_requests pr
    LEFT JOIN project_pr_metrics prm ON pr.id = prm.id
    JOIN project_mapping pm ON pr.base_repo_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(prm.pr_deployed_date)
    AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
  GROUP BY pr.id, pr.created_date, prm.pr_coding_time
)
SELECT AVG(coding_time) as 'Average PR Coding Time (h)'
FROM _prs

panels.description: Weekly average bounded cycle time trend

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounded_issues AS (
  SELECT 
    i.id as issue_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN ish.original_status = '${start_status}' THEN ish.start_date END) as start_time,
    MIN(CASE WHEN ish.original_status = '${end_status}' THEN ish.start_date END) as end_time
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON i.id = bi.issue_id
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON bi.board_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
  JOIN issue_status_history ish ON i.id = ish.issue_id
  WHERE 
    pm.project_name IN (${project})
    AND i.original_type IN (${issue_type})
    AND ish.original_status IN ('${start_status}', '${end_status}')
  GROUP BY i.id
  HAVING start_time IS NOT NULL 
    AND end_time IS NOT NULL 
    AND end_time > start_time
    AND $__timeFilter(end_time)
)
SELECT 
  DATE(end_time) as time,
  AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, start_time, end_time) / 60.0) as 'Avg Bounded Cycle Time (h)'
FROM bounded_issues
GROUP BY DATE(end_time)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 5. Bounded Cycle Time Trend

panels.description: Individual issues with bounded cycle time and PR metrics

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounded_issues AS (
  SELECT 
    i.id as issue_id,
    i.issue_key,
    i.title,
    i.url,
    MIN(CASE WHEN ish.original_status = '${start_status}' THEN ish.start_date END) as start_time,
    MIN(CASE WHEN ish.original_status = '${end_status}' THEN ish.start_date END) as end_time
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON i.id = bi.issue_id
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON bi.board_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
  JOIN issue_status_history ish ON i.id = ish.issue_id
  WHERE 
    pm.project_name IN (${project})
    AND i.original_type IN (${issue_type})
    AND ish.original_status IN ('${start_status}', '${end_status}')
  GROUP BY i.id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.url
  HAVING start_time IS NOT NULL 
    AND end_time IS NOT NULL 
    AND end_time > start_time
    AND $__timeFilter(end_time)
),
status_times AS (
  SELECT 
    ish.issue_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ish.original_status LIKE '%Dev%' OR ish.original_status LIKE '%Progress%' OR ish.original_status LIKE '%Code%' THEN ish.status_time_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 as dev_time,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ish.original_status LIKE '%QA%' OR ish.original_status LIKE '%Test%' OR ish.original_status LIKE '%Verif%' THEN ish.status_time_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 as sqa_time
  FROM issue_status_history ish
  JOIN bounded_issues bi ON ish.issue_id = bi.issue_id
  WHERE ish.start_date >= bi.start_time AND ish.start_date <= bi.end_time
  GROUP BY ish.issue_id
)
SELECT 
  bi.issue_key as 'Issue Key',
  bi.title as 'Title',
  bi.url as url_hidden,
  ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, bi.start_time, bi.end_time) / 60.0, 2) as 'Bounded Cycle Time',
  ROUND(COALESCE(st.dev_time, 0), 2) as 'Dev Time',
  ROUND(COALESCE(st.sqa_time, 0), 2) as 'SQA Time'
FROM bounded_issues bi
LEFT JOIN status_times st ON bi.issue_id = st.issue_id
ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, bi.start_time, bi.end_time) DESC
